- R2 is porous but has **hydrophobic treatment** to protect against humidity
- R3 is porous with no mention of protection, likely most vulnerable to humidity

- Porous materials without treatment (R3) typically have poor humidity resistance
- Hydrophobic treatment (R2) improves humidity resistance significantly
- Solid materials (R1) generally have excellent humidity resistance
